name: Azure Data Lake Storage
sku: Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, which is a set of capabilities enabled on a Blob Storage account by turning on the hierarchical namespace.

store.object-store.note: A cloud-based enterprise data lake built on Azure Blob Storage. It stores data in any format, adds a hierarchical directory structure and Hadoop-compatible access, and sets no limits on account size, file size or total data stored.

bands.note: Supports both Azure role-based access control and POSIX-style access control lists, with permissions set at directory or file level. It does not restrict columns or rows.
Automated lifecycle policy management and object-level tiering, inherited from Blob Storage, manage storage cost.

presentation.tagline: Object storage with a directory hierarchy, built for analytics on Azure.
